label: The trigger-index freshness gap: the committed retrieval artifact answers EVERY Gate 1 prompt (SKILL.md:432) yet no workflow regenerates or canaries it (rg over .github/workflows: EMPTY) and the lookup validates shape only (assertTriggerIndexShape, lookup-trigger-index.mjs:25; no stale/fresh/generatedAt guard) — staleness decays silently at exit 0; the only freshness mechanism is AI discipline. Recommendation: fix (freshness signal or CI canary) or, minimally, document the staleness risk where the lookup is mandated.

Four of seven retrieval root scripts have no wired caller (rg over the 5 surfaces + workflows: NONE-FOUND, and neither registry lists any): rg-wrapper.mjs (documented AI-usage, 2 conventions mentions), retrofit-convention.mjs, sweep-memory-residue.mjs, measure-cold-lookup.mjs — the latter three are the 001-acceptance build-verify-measure residue, kept in the production tree with 10 frozen-baseline fixtures. Recommendation: remove the migration trio once 001 evidence is archived; keep rg-wrapper only while the conventions point at it.

Dependency-direction story vs a live crossing: retrieval/generate-trigger-index.mjs:44 imports findRepoRoot from ../../hooks/lib/workspace/repo-root.mjs (cli->runtime/hooks/lib) while ARCHITECTURE.md:100 gates reaches past runtime/api into lib/core/handlers — and the governed allowlist (evals/import-policy-allowlist.json) contains no hooks/workspace/repo-root entry (grep: EMPTY); either hooks/ is quietly outside the governed zones or the .mjs lane escapes the check (whether the check would flag it: caller-not-checked — iteration 8). Compounding: 3 repo-root implementations coexist (cli/common.sh get_repo_root, used by create/upgrade/scaffold/heal; runtime/hooks/lib/workspace/repo-root.mjs; shared/paths pending). Recommendation: fix — govern or route via api; converge repo-root onto one seam.

graph/ is more wired than its documentation, except its twin: spec/repair-derived.cjs:40,319 spawns cli/graph/backfill-graph-metadata.ts inside the CI repair lane (strict-pass-freshness-report.yml -> repair-derived -> BACKFILL) and the doctor surface wires it twice (doctor-update.yaml, doctor-runtime-bootstrap.sh), yet cli/README.md:7 presents backfill as purely manual; conversely graph/migrate-generated-json.ts has no wired caller in the five surfaces. The repair split (referee repairs-derived vs doer backfill) is delegation, not duplication. Recommendation: document the delegation; migrate-generated-json.ts is a removal candidate after its migration is confirmed consumed.
